questions.text: What are the external actors and systems that interact with the municipal problem reporting and management system at its boundary?
What are the externally reachable entry points and their associated authentication mechanisms for users reporting problems?
What trust-zone crossings exist when citizen-submitted problem reports are ingested and processed by the municipality?
What are the main data stores and core data flows involved in capturing and managing municipal problems?
What deployable artifacts and execution nodes comprise the deployment architecture for the system?
